title: server
description: The record a detached serve writes for every app, so servers, servers stop and servers link find it (ADR-S04); each server on a thing leaves one (ADR-S12). Two app versions read it at once: apiVersion, kind and metadata never change; spec may grow (ADR-S15).

apiVersion.description: The form the record is in. It never changes, so two app versions on one machine both read every record (ADR-S15).

kind.description: Always Server, the kind of this record.

metadata.description: Which server this is: its app, address and process. It never changes in v1 (ADR-S15).

app.description: The product ID of the app that serves. servers stop signals a process only while its address answers as this app.

addr.description: The address the server bound. servers asks it whether the server still answers, and a record is found and removed by it.

pid.description: The server's process, which servers stop signals; only while addr still answers as the app, since a pid can be reused.

name.description: The thing it serves, when it serves one, so a person sees which board or design each server shows (ADR-S08).

version.description: The app's version, so a person sees servers of different versions side by side and the UI can warn when servers on one thing differ (ADR-S06, ADR-S12).

startedAt.description: When the server started, as an RFC 3339 time, so a person sees how long it has run.

log.description: Where the detached server writes its output, so a person can read why it failed or stopped.

detached.description: Started with serve --detach; a server in the foreground has a terminal instead, where a person stops it.

spec.description: What the server says about itself. Open: a newer app may add fields here, and an older reader accepts them (CT-RULE-4).
